test.name: read-only Stripe return recovery exposes a released prior-use denial only after binding proof

intended.text:
assert.deepEqual(
    f.effects.find((e) => e[0] === "cancel"),
    ["cancel", "sub_trial", { invoice_now: false, prorate: false }],
  )

assertion.message:
|-
    Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
    + actual - expected
    
      [
        'cancel',
        'sub_trial',
        {
    +     invoice_now: true,
    -     invoice_now: false,
          prorate: false
        }
      ]

expected.text:
assert.deepEqual(
    f.effects.find((e) => e[0] === "cancel"),
    ["cancel", "sub_trial", { invoice_now: false, prorate: false }],
  )
